user.title: Global Caché iTach
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your iTach (TCP port 4998 by default).

pick_device.title: Select gateway
pick_device.description: Choose a gateway discovered on your network, or enter an address manually.

dhcp.title: Discovered Global Caché gateway
dhcp.description: A Global Caché device was found on your network.

discovery.title: Discovered Global Caché gateway
discovery.description: A Global Caché device was found on your network.

reconfigure.title: Update connection
reconfigure.description: Change the gateway IP or hostname. The integration will reconnect and refresh device capabilities.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or query the device. Check the address, port, and network.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this gateway is already in progress.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect or query the discovered device.

send_infrared_failed.message: Failed to send IR on connector {connector}: {error}

init.title: iTach options
init.description: Adjust IR defaults, timeouts, remotes, relays, or serial ports.

remote_command_form.title: Command
remote_command_form.description: Enter one infrared command. Leave frequency, repeat, offset, and sendir ID blank to use the remote and gateway defaults.

remote_command_import.title: Import commands
remote_command_import.description: One JSON array of command objects, with a comma between objects. Import replaces every command on this remote.

edit_remote.title: Edit remote
edit_remote.description: Choose a remote to change its name, IR connector, or command list.

learn_ir.title: Learn IR command
learn_ir.description: Capture a code with the iTach pinhole learner and add it to a remote as a button. If you have no remotes yet, enter a name and IR connector here to create one. {ir_hint}

learn_ir_capture.title: Capture IR
learn_ir_capture.description: Click Submit, then within {timeout}s hold the handheld remote 1–2 inches from the iTach pinhole and press the button for “{command}”. {detail}

edit_relay.title: Edit relay
edit_relay.description: Change name or module/port for a configured relay.

serial_command_form.title: Preset
serial_command_form.description: Enter one preset. It becomes a button on this serial port.

serial_command_import.title: Import presets
serial_command_import.description: One JSON array of {name, payload} objects, with a comma between objects. Import replaces every preset. Use [] for none.

edit_serial.title: Edit serial port
edit_serial.description: Change name, connector, line settings, or preset buttons.

error.command_fields: Enter a name and the command text.
error.invalid_json: That is not valid JSON. Use one array, with a comma between objects.
error.commands_not_array: Commands must be one JSON array, not several arrays.
error.bad_format: Format must be Pronto hex, Global Caché pulse pairs, or a full sendir line.
error.duplicate_command: Another command already uses that button name.
error.command_override_range: Frequency, repeat, offset, or sendir ID is outside the allowed range.
error.not_loaded: Integration is not loaded. Reload Global Caché iTach and try again.

abort.no_remotes: Add a remote first, then use Learn IR command.
